difficulty.reason: HubSpot requires creating a developer account, configuring app settings, and managing specific scopes. While private apps or standard public apps are straightforward to set up, publishing to the marketplace requires rigorous security reviews.

timeEstimate.approvalWait: 1 to 5 business days for Marketplace/Public apps (private apps or developer test accounts often require no review)
timeEstimate.notes: Developer test accounts allow instant local testing without waiting for app approval.

requirements: HubSpot Developer Account or Developer Test Account
Valid Redirect URL for OAuth 2.0 flow
Selection of appropriate OAuth scopes matching the AI agent's required HubSpot interactions
Privacy policy and terms of service URLs (required for public apps)

steps.title: Create a HubSpot Developer Account
steps.description: Sign up for a free HubSpot developer account or log into your existing HubSpot portal.

steps.title: Create a New App
steps.description: Navigate to the Apps section in your developer account and click 'Create app'.

steps.title: Configure Auth Settings
steps.description: Set up your Auth settings by adding your redirect URLs and noting your Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Select Scopes
steps.description: Choose the necessary OAuth 2.0 scopes (e.g., crm.objects.contacts.read, crm.objects.deals.write) required by your AI agent.

blockers.problem: Incorrect or missing redirect URL leading to redirect_mismatch errors.
blockers.solution: Ensure the redirect URI registered in the HubSpot app settings matches the URI passed in your authorization request character-for-character.

blockers.problem: Requesting scopes that require additional permissions or app marketplace review.
blockers.solution: Use a developer test account to test sensitive or restricted scopes before submitting your app for public review.

agentCanDo: Generate PKCE parameters and authorization URL strings
Exchange authorization codes for access and refresh tokens
Programmatically invoke HubSpot APIs using valid tokens
developerMustDo: Log into the HubSpot developer portal using 2FA
Create the app entity and configure redirect URIs manually
Accept terms of service and submit app for marketplace review if public

managedOption.managedSufficientWhen: Building standard AI agents that need pre-built connectors to read and write CRM data without publishing a standalone public integration to the HubSpot Marketplace.
managedOption.customRequiredWhen: Building a commercial product intended to be listed publicly on the HubSpot App Marketplace under your own brand identity and client credentials.

claims.claim: HubSpot apps are managed and registered via the HubSpot Developer Portal.
Developer test accounts allow instant testing without approval waits.

openQuestions: Are there specific automated security scanning requirements (like CASA) currently mandated for all public HubSpot Marketplace listings?
